findings.text: blocking: the done_when's "inventory, roadmap and discovery outputs for that tree are equal at base and head" is not demonstrated — the recorded dumps (frozen-readers-base.json vs frozen-readers-head.json) differ on 97 fields including many roadmap.decision_blockers entries and active_sprint_id S25->S26, so the two arms raced a live checkout; the manifest characterises the divergence as active_sprint_id alone and so overstates its own evidence.

follow-on: parse_meta_head_shared is a near-verbatim copy of parse_meta_shared at :130 (same lock, _META_MAX_ENTRIES bound, deepcopy and OSError fallback, differing only in cache dict and delegate), forking the digest-memo mechanism rather than factoring a shared helper.

follow-on: the file is rewritten outside the plan §14 declared write paths; the change was necessary because it counted the read_state entries this node removes, but the run's recorded write_paths must be extended for it to be in scope.

follow-on: parse_meta_head (and metadata_index.py:160 parse_meta_head_shared) are added as non-underscored module-level functions, contradicting §14's deliverable that "no public function or option is added".
